PasskeyStepUpVerifyRequest.description: Passkey verification for the step-up of an open session.

RegisterPasskeyRequest.description: Registration of a passkey with the authenticator response.

CreateTenantRequest.description: Creation of a tenant by the user.

UpdateTenantRequest.description: Partial changes of the current tenant.

MyTenantSummary.description: Tenant of the user with the date they joined.

routes.name: signIn
routes.description: Signs in with email and password. Responds with tokens or an MFA challenge.

routes.name: requestMfaChallenge
routes.description: Creates an MFA challenge for the pending login and sends the code through the chosen method.

routes.name: verifyMfa
routes.description: Verifies an MFA challenge, creates the session and registers the new device.

routes.name: refreshSession
routes.description: Rotates the session token (body on mobile, httpOnly cookie on web) and issues a new access token.

routes.name: signOut
routes.description: Closes the session of the session token, revokes its tokens and clears the cookie on web.

routes.name: startStepUp
routes.description: Opens the step-up of the current session and returns the methods it offers.

routes.name: requestStepUpChallenge
routes.description: Creates the step-up challenge and sends the code through the chosen method.

routes.name: verifyStepUp
routes.description: Verifies the step-up, updates the last MFA of the session and issues a new access token.

routes.name: getSessionAccess
routes.description: Returns user, tenant, permissions, roles, plan, flags and last MFA of the current session.

routes.name: listSessions
routes.description: Lists the active sessions of the user, current one first.

routes.name: revokeSession
routes.description: Closes a session of the user and revokes its tokens.

routes.name: revokeOtherSessions
routes.description: Closes all sessions of the user except the current one.

routes.name: listDevices
routes.description: Lists the user devices with active trust.

routes.name: signUp
routes.description: Registers a user and sends the verification email. Responds accepted without revealing whether the email already exists.

routes.name: resendEmailVerification
routes.description: Sends a new verification email. Responds accepted even if the email does not exist.

routes.name: confirmEmailVerification
routes.description: Marks the user email as verified with the received token.

routes.name: changePassword
routes.description: Changes the password and closes the other sessions of the user.

routes.name: requestPasswordReset
routes.description: Sends the password reset email. Responds accepted even if the email does not exist.

routes.name: confirmPasswordReset
routes.description: Resets the password with the emailed token and closes the user sessions.

routes.name: getProfile
routes.description: Returns the profile of the authenticated user.

routes.name: updateProfile
routes.description: Changes the profile name or language and returns the new profile.

routes.name: requestEmailChange
routes.description: Sends a token to the new address to confirm the email change.

routes.name: confirmEmailChange
routes.description: Applies the email change with the token sent to the new address.

routes.name: getJwks
routes.description: Returns the active public keys in JWKS format to verify access tokens.

routes.name: removeDevice
routes.description: Removes a device from the account and closes its sessions.

routes.name: untrustDevice
routes.description: Removes the trust of a device without deleting its record.

routes.name: updatePushToken
routes.description: Saves or replaces the push token of the current device.

routes.name: pullDeviceApprovals
routes.description: Returns the pending approvals of the device that signs the request.

routes.name: denyDeviceApproval
routes.description: Rejects a pending approval from the device that signs the request.

routes.name: startTotpEnrollment
routes.description: Creates the TOTP secret and its URI. The factor becomes active once confirmed.

routes.name: confirmTotpEnrollment
routes.description: Confirms the TOTP with the first code and returns the recovery codes.

routes.name: removeTotp
routes.description: Removes the TOTP from the account and sends a security alert.

routes.name: regenerateRecoveryCodes
routes.description: Replaces the recovery codes and returns the new ones only once.

routes.name: startMfaRecovery
routes.description: Starts MFA recovery and sends the token by email. It is confirmed after the indicated wait.

routes.name: confirmMfaRecovery
routes.description: Confirms MFA recovery, disables the previous factors and creates the session.

routes.name: passkeySignInOptions
routes.description: Creates the challenge for a passkey sign-in.

routes.name: passkeySignInVerify
routes.description: Verifies the passkey response and returns tokens or an MFA challenge.

routes.name: passkeyMfaOptions
routes.description: Creates the passkey challenge for the second factor of a pending login.

routes.name: passkeyMfaVerify
routes.description: Verifies the passkey as second factor and creates the session.

routes.name: passkeyStepUpOptions
routes.description: Creates the passkey challenge for the step-up of an open session.

routes.name: passkeyStepUpVerify
routes.description: Verifies the step-up passkey and returns an access token with the new MFA.

routes.name: listPasskeys
routes.description: Lists the registered passkeys of the user.

routes.name: passkeyRegistrationOptions
routes.description: Creates the challenge to register a new passkey.

routes.name: registerPasskey
routes.description: Registers a new passkey with the authenticator response.

routes.name: removePasskey
routes.description: Removes a passkey from the account.

routes.name: switchTenant
routes.description: Switches the tenant of the open session and returns tokens for the chosen tenant.

routes.name: createTenant
routes.description: Starts provisioning a tenant and makes the authenticated user its owner.

routes.name: getTenant
routes.description: Returns the tenant of the current session.

routes.name: updateTenant
routes.description: Changes the name of the current session tenant.

routes.name: listMyTenants
routes.description: Lists the tenants the user belongs to.

routes.name: listMembers
routes.description: Lists the members of the tenant with their groups, a page at a time.

routes.name: removeMember
routes.description: Removes a member from the tenant and revokes their sessions in it.

routes.name: setMemberGroups
routes.description: Replaces the groups of a member of the tenant.

routes.name: listGroups
routes.description: Lists the groups of the tenant.

routes.name: createGroup
routes.description: Creates a group in the tenant.

routes.name: updateGroup
routes.description: Renames a group of the tenant.

routes.name: deleteGroup
routes.description: Deletes a group of the tenant and takes its members out of it.

routes.name: setGroupRoles
routes.description: Replaces the roles of a group of the tenant.

routes.name: listRoles
routes.description: Lists the roles of the tenant with their permissions.

routes.name: createRole
routes.description: Creates a custom role with its permissions.

routes.name: updateRole
routes.description: Renames a role of the tenant or changes its permissions.

routes.name: deleteRole
routes.description: Deletes a custom role of the tenant. System roles are not deleted.

routes.name: inviteUser
routes.description: Invites an email to join the tenant in the given groups.

routes.name: listInvitations
routes.description: Lists the invitations of the tenant with their status.

routes.name: revokeInvitation
routes.description: Revokes a pending invitation.

routes.name: acceptInvitation
routes.description: Accepts an invitation. The email of the session must be the invited one and verified, its inviter must still be able to grant its groups, and the plan of the tenant must have a seat.

routes.name: listServiceAccounts
routes.description: Lists the service accounts of the tenant.

routes.name: createServiceAccount
routes.description: Creates a service account with the given permissions.

routes.name: updateServiceAccount
routes.description: Changes the name or the permissions of a service account.

routes.name: deleteServiceAccount
routes.description: Deletes a service account and revokes its API keys.

routes.name: listApiKeys
routes.description: Lists the API keys of a service account without their secrets.

routes.name: createApiKey
routes.description: Creates an API key whose account permissions the caller holds. The secret appears only in this response.

routes.name: rotateApiKey
routes.description: Rotates an active API key whose account permissions the caller holds: the new one appears once and the previous one stays valid for the grace period.

routes.name: revokeApiKey
routes.description: Revokes an API key at once.

routes.name: startAccountDeletion
routes.description: Starts the deletion of the account of the authenticated user, unless they are the last owner of a tenant with other members. The saga is read with its id.

routes.name: getSaga
routes.description: Returns the status of an own saga or one of the tenant.

operations.name: revokeUserSessions
operations.compensationReason: Revoking sessions is not undone for security: the user signs in again.
operations.description: Revokes all sessions of a user and publishes the event.

operations.name: getUserAccess
operations.description: Returns permissions, roles, features and flags of a user in a tenant.

operations.name: suspendUser
operations.description: Suspends a user and revokes their sessions.

operations.name: reactivateUser
operations.description: Reactivates a suspended user.

operations.name: getUserProfile
operations.description: Returns the profile of a user.

operations.name: createTenant
operations.description: Creates a tenant being provisioned with its owner.

operations.name: discardTenant
operations.compensationReason: Only deletes a tenant being provisioned, which has no business data to restore.
operations.description: Discards a tenant being provisioned.

operations.name: suspendTenant
operations.description: Suspends a tenant and revokes its tokens.

operations.name: reactivateTenant
operations.description: Reactivates a suspended tenant.

operations.name: authenticateApiKey
operations.description: Validates an API key and returns its principal.

operations.name: activateTenant
operations.compensationReason: Runs after the saga pivot: it is retried until completed and is not reverted.
operations.description: Activates a tenant being provisioned.

operations.name: eraseUser
operations.compensationReason: Erasing personal data is irreversible and runs after the saga pivot.
operations.description: Erases the personal data of a user.

operations.name: listPushTargets
operations.description: Returns the devices of a user with a push token.

operations.name: listMembersByPermission
operations.description: Pages the members of a tenant that have a permission.

operations.name: tenantMoveSync
operations.description: Copies a batch of the tenant data in identity to the target while writes continue; the saga repeats until the round completes.

operations.name: tenantMoveFinalize
operations.description: Copies the last round of identity with the tenant frozen and verifies counts and sums.

operations.name: tenantMoveAbort
operations.compensationReason: Only runs as compensation of the copy: discards what was copied to the target and there is nothing to restore.
operations.description: Cancels the move of a tenant and discards what was copied from identity to the target.

operations.name: tenantMoveSwitch
operations.compensationReason: Runs after the pivot: the tenant already lives in the target and it is retried until completed.
operations.description: Points identity to the target of the moved tenant and reopens its writes.

operations.name: tenantMoveCleanup
operations.compensationReason: Deletes from the source the data already moved once the grace period expires: it is not restored.
operations.description: Deletes from identity the data of the moved tenant when the grace period ends.

operations.name: finishTenantMove
operations.compensationReason: Runs after the saga pivot: it is retried until completed and is not reverted.
operations.description: Marks a tenant move as switched in all services.

events.name: sessionRevoked
events.description: A session was revoked. The realtime gateway closes its connections.

events.name: tokensRevoked
events.description: The tokens of a session, a user or a tenant were revoked. Each service updates its cache.

events.name: userSuspended
events.description: A user was suspended and their sessions were revoked.

events.name: userEmailChanged
events.description: The email of a user changed. It does not include addresses.

events.name: deviceRegistered
events.description: A device that can approve sensitive actions was registered.

events.name: deviceRemoved
events.description: A device was removed from the account.

events.name: tenantSuspended
events.description: A tenant was suspended and its tokens were revoked.

events.name: membershipChanged
events.description: The membership of a user in a tenant changed.

events.name: permissionsChanged
events.description: The permissions of a user or a tenant changed. Without userId it affects the whole tenant.

events.name: apiKeyCreated
events.description: An API key was created. It does not include the secret.

events.name: securityAlertRaised
events.description: A security alert was raised on an account. Notifies the user through their channel.

events.name: userErased
events.description: The personal data of a user was erased. Services that keep a trace of the user delete or anonymize it.

commands.name: sendPasswordReset
commands.description: Looks up the account of the email and, if it can reset its password, sends it the reset email.

IdentityErrorCode.name: AuthInvalidCredentials
IdentityErrorCode.description: The email or password is not valid, or the origin is blocked after failed attempts.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaTokenInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The MFA challenge does not exist or expired. Sign in again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaCodeInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The verification code is not correct.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaCodeExpired
IdentityErrorCode.description: The verification code expired. Request a new one.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaTooManyAttempts
IdentityErrorCode.description: The challenge attempts ran out. Request a new one.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaStepUpRequired
IdentityErrorCode.description: The operation requires verifying the second factor again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaMethodUnavailable
IdentityErrorCode.description: The requested method is not among those offered by the MFA challenge. Choose another.

IdentityErrorCode.name: SessionRevoked
IdentityErrorCode.description: The session was closed. Sign in again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: SessionExpired
IdentityErrorCode.description: The session expired due to inactivity or the absolute limit. Sign in again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: SessionReused
IdentityErrorCode.description: An already rotated session token was presented. The whole session was revoked. Sign in again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TokenStalePermissions
IdentityErrorCode.description: Permissions changed since the token was issued. The client refreshes and retries.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TokenRevoked
IdentityErrorCode.description: The access token was revoked by the user or tenant epoch. Sign in again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: UserNotFound
IdentityErrorCode.description: The user does not exist.

IdentityErrorCode.name: UserSuspended
IdentityErrorCode.description: The user is suspended. Their sessions stay closed until reactivated.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantSuspended
IdentityErrorCode.description: The tenant is suspended. Sessions in it stay closed until reactivated.

IdentityErrorCode.name: AuthEmailNotVerified
IdentityErrorCode.description: The email is not verified yet. Confirm the link sent to your email.

IdentityErrorCode.name: UserEmailVerificationInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The email verification link is not valid or expired. Request a new one.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasswordPolicyViolation
IdentityErrorCode.description: The password does not meet the policy: 12 to 128 characters and different from the email.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasswordBreached
IdentityErrorCode.description: The password appears in known breaches. Choose another.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasswordCurrentInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The current password is not correct.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasswordResetInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The password reset link is not valid or expired. Request a new one.

IdentityErrorCode.name: DeviceSignatureInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The device signature is not valid.

IdentityErrorCode.name: DeviceKeyInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The device public key is not valid.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaRecoveryNotReady
IdentityErrorCode.description: Second factor recovery is not available yet. Try again when the waiting period ends.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaFactorAlreadyEnrolled
IdentityErrorCode.description: That second factor is already active.

IdentityErrorCode.name: MfaFactorNotEnrolled
IdentityErrorCode.description: That second factor is not active.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasskeyVerificationFailed
IdentityErrorCode.description: The passkey could not be verified.

IdentityErrorCode.name: PasskeyChallengeExpired
IdentityErrorCode.description: The passkey challenge expired. Try again.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantNotFound
IdentityErrorCode.description: The tenant does not exist.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantSlugTaken
IdentityErrorCode.description: The tenant identifier is already in use. Choose another.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantNotMember
IdentityErrorCode.description: You are not a member of that tenant.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantMoveNotMovable
IdentityErrorCode.description: The shared customer tenant and the platform tenant spread their data across all shards and are not moved.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantMoveUnknownTarget
IdentityErrorCode.description: The move target is not a configured shard group or is already the tenant location.

IdentityErrorCode.name: TenantMoveInProgress
IdentityErrorCode.description: The tenant already has a move in progress.

IdentityErrorCode.name: AccessLastOwner
IdentityErrorCode.description: The tenant must keep at least one owner.

IdentityErrorCode.name: AccessSystemRoleImmutable
IdentityErrorCode.description: System roles cannot be modified or deleted.

IdentityErrorCode.name: AccessNameTaken
IdentityErrorCode.description: A group or role with that name already exists.

IdentityErrorCode.name: InvitationInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The invitation is not valid, expired or was already used.

IdentityErrorCode.name: InvitationEmailMismatch
IdentityErrorCode.description: The verified email of your account does not match the invitation email.

IdentityErrorCode.name: ApiKeyInvalid
IdentityErrorCode.description: The API key is not valid.

IdentityErrorCode.name: ApiKeyExpired
IdentityErrorCode.description: The API key expired.

IdentityErrorCode.name: ApiKeyIpNotAllowed
IdentityErrorCode.description: The API key cannot be used from this IP address.

IdentityErrorCode.name: ApiKeyPermissionNotGrantable
IdentityErrorCode.description: You cannot grant permissions your account does not have.

IdentityErrorCode.name: ServiceAccountDisabled
IdentityErrorCode.description: The service account is disabled.
